description: This file defines the CommentsController class which handles HTTP requests related to comments on articles, including creating, retrieving, and deleting comments. It utilizes Mediator pattern to delegate actions and enforces authorization on certain endpoints.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller for handling comment-related HTTP endpoints, including creating, listing, and deleting comments.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by id from an article identified by slug.
